import numpy as np
Ft={'1':np.ones_like(t),'st':np.sqrt(t),'s1':np.sqrt(1+t),'t':t,'lt':np.log(t),'l1':np.log1p(t),'t^1.5':t**1.5}
Gp={'1':np.ones_like(P),'P':P,'P2':P**2,'P3':P**3,'sP':np.sqrt(P),'PlP':P*np.log(P),'P1.5':P**1.5,'lP':np.log(P),'P2lP':P**2*np.log(P),'sPlP':np.sqrt(P)*np.log(P)}
cols=[];names=[]
for a in Ft:
  for b in Gp:
    cols.append(Ft[a]*Gp[b]); names.append(a+'*'+b)
A=np.column_stack(cols); c,_,_,_=np.linalg.lstsq(A,dP_dt,rcond=None); r=dP_dt-A@c
print('all',np.sqrt(np.mean(r**2)), np.sqrt(np.mean(r**2))/np.std(dP_dt))
# sparsify: backward elimination by smallest |coef|*std
keep=list(range(len(cols)))
while len(keep)>8:
    A=np.column_stack([cols[i] for i in keep]); c,_,_,_=np.linalg.lstsq(A,dP_dt,rcond=None)
    r=dP_dt-A@c; e=np.sqrt(np.mean(r**2))
    # drop term whose removal hurts least
    best=None;be=1e9
    for j in range(len(keep)):
        kk=keep[:j]+keep[j+1:]
        A2=np.column_stack([cols[i] for i in kk]); c2,_,_,_=np.linalg.lstsq(A2,dP_dt,rcond=None)
        e2=np.sqrt(np.mean((dP_dt-A2@c2)**2))
        if e2<be: be=e2;best=j
    keep.pop(best)
    print(len(keep), round(be,5), [names[i] for i in keep] if len(keep)<=8 else '')

def equation(t, P, params):
